body.x: Catspad participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a smart solution for caring cats.

Catspad is a smart pet care solution which consists of a cat feeder and a related app. Catspad enables you to provide your cat with food and water through your smartphone wherever you are. Using this app, you can easily schedule at what time, how often, and how much the food is dispensed to feed your cat. Furthermore, whenever your cat’s water bowl is empty, water can be supplied therein. Catspad can also identify your cat by way of sensing a chip or necklace attached or worn by your cat while enabling you to personally record and manage your cat’s profile including name, age, breeding-related data, etc.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
